verdicts.title: Wrappers named 'round' and 'pow' shadow Python builtins in the star-imported public namespace
verdicts.reasoning: Independently verified all evidence. _math.py line 14: '"ceil", "floor", "trunc", "round", "rint", "nearbyint",' and line 18: '"pow", "fmod", "remainder",' both place those names in __all__. Wrapper definitions confirmed at lines 152-154 ('def round(x): return _call_lib_func("round", (x,))') and 197-199 ('def pow(x, y): return _call_lib_func("pow", (x, y))'). __init__.py line 2: 'from numbox.core.bindings._math import *  # noqa: F401, F403' confirms the star-import chain. The shadowing is therefore real and observable. The renaming-is-not-warranted constraint is correctly identified (CLAUDE.md: 'Function names must match the C library names exactly'). Low severity stands: this is a misuse hazard, not a correctness defect in the wrappers themselves.
